name: AI UI Style Vault 3D Delivery Runtime Source Policy

sources.browserSupport: Last two major versions of evergreen desktop and mobile browsers, per upstream package README at the pinned review date.
rules: Prefer installing the published package or using the official hosted build rather than copying repository internals.
When source or example code is redistributed or modified, preserve Apache-2.0 obligations, notices and modification notices as applicable.
Pin @google/model-viewer and its tested Three.js peer version for production; do not silently force an incompatible Three.js version.
Shared upstream demo models, environment maps and other assets are separate resources; verify their individual provenance before copying them into a production site.
Do not use Google trademarks or demo branding as part of the target business identity.
The runtime never makes an unverified model, property, product or claim accurate merely because it renders successfully.
